title: Explore Miami Like a Local: Top Attractions & Hidden Gems
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the most iconic corners of the city with local guides who are passionate about sharing the history, culture, and secrets of this vibrant metropolis. From the colorful murals of Wynwood to the authentic flavors of Little Havana, you’ll enjoy an unforgettable experience in a comfortable, fun, and personalized setting.

Our groups are small to ensure personalized attention and a real connection with the places we visit. Would you like to try Cuban coffee, stroll through art-filled streets, or snap the perfect photo in front of the Miami skyline? This tour is for you!
